meta.title: Tasweet
meta.description: A trusted public opinion platform: vote on current topics in Saudi Arabia and see where the public stands.

home.noTopics: No open topics right now. Check back soon.

methodology.title: Methodology
methodology.body: Results reflect verified Tasweet voters, not all of KSA. A full explanation of how votes are verified and how the trust score works will be published here.

principles.title: Credibility over volume
principles.body: Only geo-verified, trusted votes count in official results.

principles.title: No pay to sway
principles.body: Money never changes a vote or a result.

principles.title: Open by default
principles.body: The code is public on GitHub and the methodology is published.

principles.title: Privacy first
principles.body: Results are only ever shown in aggregate, never as individual votes.

principles.title: Moderated, not censored
principles.body: Every topic is reviewed before going live, against a published topic policy.

submit.title: Suggest a topic
submit.intro: Write a question with two options. Moderators review it before it goes live.
policy: No political or religious topics, and no named people.
Neutral wording and two balanced options.
A clear question that either option can answer.
submit.questionPlaceholder: Example: Do you prefer travelling in summer or in winter?
submit.sentBody: Moderators review every topic against the topic policy before it goes live, and may adjust the wording to keep it neutral.

errors.invalid_question: Write a question between 10 and 200 characters.
errors.invalid_options: Write two different options, each 60 characters or fewer.
errors.invalid_description: Shorten the details to 500 characters or fewer.
